title: Annotatio III §.VI open: Ortus gained but obscure/private — public light only in the eleventh century
pass_a_gloss: §. VI. In this way indeed Transsubstantiation obtained its Ortus, but obscure and private, hereafter to be sent forth into public light by public authority — which at last happened in the eleventh Century.
pass_b_english: §.VI: Transsubstantiation has its Ortus — but still obscure and private.
Public authority will push it into public light only in the eleventh century.
source_text: §. VI. Hoc pacto quidem Ortum suum nacta est Transsubstantiatio, sed obscurum privatumque, publicâ autoritate olim in lucem publicam emittenda, id quod Seculo demum XI. contigit.

lemmas.gloss: at last in the eleventh Century
